notes:
What's new in 0.24.0

• Home: the row you move to sits in the middle of the screen, never cut off at the bottom. Each row ends with Show More, which opens the whole list.
• Back on Home, Movies, Series, Anime, Live TV, Discover or My List goes up to the top bar. Everywhere else it goes back one step.
• Pick for Me: Back on your pick goes straight back to Movies, Series or Anime.
• Settings > Playback > Anime audio: prefer dubs (dubbed and dual-audio sources first) or the original Japanese with subtitles.
• Live TV: OK shows the info bar (press OK again for the channel list), and Up/Down change channel.
• My List: with Trakt connected, choose where to save it — My List, your Trakt watchlist or any of your Trakt lists.
• Settings: moving left from a page goes back to that page's own entry instead of jumping to another section.
• The Zylo logo in the top bar can't be selected any more.
• Subtitles set to Off now stay off, even when the file marks a foreign track as its default.
